acquisition method: After the survey scan, the 20 most intense precursor ions were selected for MS/MS fragmentation.
collision energy: Fragmentation was performed with a normalized collision energy of 27 eV
instrument: MS analysis was performed via a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
labeling: MS analysis was performed via a Q Exactive HF mass spectrometer (Thermo Scientific).
mass analyzer: The full-scan method employed, m/z 375–1600 mass selection, an Orbitrap resolution of 120,000 (at m/z 200)
precursor tolerance: The precursor and fragment mass tolerances were set to 10 ppm and 0.02 Da, respectively
fragment tolerance: The precursor and fragment mass tolerances were set to 10 ppm and 0.02 Da, respectively
ptm: carbamidomethylation of cysteines (fixed); acetylation of the N-terminus (variable); oxidation of methionine (variable)
allowing 1 missed cleavage, carbamidomethylation of cysteines as a fixed modification, and acetylation of the N-terminus and oxidation of methionine as variable modifications.
